body.claim: Changing the index schema without bumping this leaves every existing index in place, serving results from the old shape.
body.detail: This constant is the entire migration mechanism for the index: is_current compares it against PRAGMA user_version and anything that does not match is rebuilt. Bumping it costs one rebuild. Forgetting to bump it costs a search that quietly returns yesterday columns — there is no error, because a database that opens and reports the expected version is by definition current.
